patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video and subsequent large image sections create an immersive, cinematic feel, often with text overlays for context.
Content sections frequently use a grid-based layout for showcasing projects or news, maintaining a clean and organized presentation.
A sticky header navigation bar reduces in height and gains a solid background color after the initial scroll past the hero section.
Major content sections and image blocks reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
A high-contrast palette of dark grays and whites is consistently used for text and backgrounds, punctuated by a single vibrant deep blue accent color for the footer and interactive elements.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background video with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text readability, over which the main heading and introductory text are positioned.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented, which initially appears transparent over the hero and then transitions to a smaller height with a solid, opaque background as the user scrolls down the page.

Content sections throughout the page are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements subtly fade in and slide upwards as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic and engaging scrolling experience, likely powered by a library like locomotive-scroll.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by lighter weight body text and small, often uppercase, labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous spacing between major sections, with moderate padding within content blocks and grid items.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, high-quality video and imagery, combined with sophisticated scroll-triggered reveals and a transforming sticky navigation, creates a highly immersive and premium brand experience. The 'Earth globe' interactive section is a particularly unique and memorable visual element.
